caribbean.headline: Small Craft Conditions Near Roatan, Heavy Rain Expected
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan (Western Caribbean) is experiencing sustained east-northeast winds near 23 kt with 5.7 ft seas and a dominant ENE swell at 9 s, and there is 75% rain probability. I recommend mariners and port operators take precautions since those sustained winds meet Small Craft Advisory thresholds; Barbados (Lesser Antilles) is the runner-up with sustained winds near 16 kt and generally lower seas.

mediterranean.headline: Small Craft Advisory Conditions Near Mykonos, Cadiz Light Winds
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing southeasterly winds up to 25 kt, seas to 6.8 ft with an ENE 7 s swell and less than 10% rain probability. I assess these conditions as meeting Small Craft Advisory criteria for small vessels near Mykonos and advise seeking sheltered waters; Cadiz remains much lighter with winds near 11 kt.
